caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the owner (onlyOwner satisfied)

pending_tx_observable.meaning: a pending increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() call is observable in the mempool by an MEV bot
pending_tx_observable.checkpoint: before the pending transaction is mined

executes_with_stale_pricing.meaning: the held transaction executes with stale pricing parameters after being held

assumptions: The owner is the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange(); the MEV bot observes the pending owner transaction in the mempool.
The deadline is caller-provided and the transaction must not execute after that deadline; the report gives block.timestamp + 5 minutes only as an example.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete caller-provided deadline value or the exact comparison between execution time and deadline; only an example (block.timestamp + 5 minutes) is stated.
Report does not quantify how long the transaction is held before stale execution, nor the stale pricing parameters' values.

limitations: Stale pricing is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report states the observable condition without numeric pricing parameters.
The deadline-expiry relation is expressed as absence of stale execution under the valid owner-initiated pending transaction scenario; concrete deadline arithmetic is deferred to code binding.
